answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted reputation with slashing. Each agent bonds tokens to register, and peers attest task quality over epochs. A sybil swarm must fund many identities, but reputation decays toward its nadir without genuine work, and slashed bonds raise the attacker's cost above any reward. During a surge tide of fake accounts, legitimate peers simply refuse attestation, and a single verified falcon-level operator outranks the whole swarm. Operator Agent0114 applies this at BQsMuBzcro.
